validation.signal: hourly completed minute-close observations at hh:00
validation.execution: next hh:01 minute OPEN, independent of signal construction
validation.funding_information: actual available_ts settlement+1h; preserve ms jitter
validation.hourly_NAV: actual next minute spot/perp open proxy reference, fees included; not minute mark NAV

capital.fraction_meaning: per-leg entry notional as fraction of current combined NAV; no auto normalization; gross twice fraction

costs.metadata: current exchange snapshots explicitly assumed for history
costs.B1_forecast_costs: base 1x cost forecast held fixed in stress paths; realized fills and paid funding stressed; quantities evolve with scenario NAV

native_recovery.native_quotes: hourly closed prices; next shared closed record fill as original engine; exact API settlement marks; known expiry same-record exit
native_recovery.purpose: restore actual results for original incomplete examples; no long-run profit acceptance based on native case alone
native_recovery.cost_scenario_signals: native original config fees/execution are stressed, so its own entry/exit gates may change
native_recovery.target_lot: floor target quantity to common current spot/perp lot; exact matched base

limits: Fixed repeated episodes are explicit extensions, not identical to original one-entry BacktestConfig
Hourly NAV MDD, not minute MDD
Current metadata and simplified 1% maintenance, not historical exchange tiers
Margin envelope uses whole hourly mark high for remaining short, conservative even before entry minute; no automatic liquidation path simulated
